title_vi: Các thuật ngữ dữ liệu cốt lõi

related.reason_vi: Pipeline là đường dẫn dữ liệu vào lake và warehouse.

claims.claim_vi: A data lake stores structured, semi-structured and unstructured data in its native format.
A data warehouse is an enterprise system for analysis and reporting of data from multiple sources, holding current and historical data.
Delta Lake is an open-source storage framework for building a lakehouse; its ACID guarantees rest on guarantees of the underlying storage system.
claims.verified_by: README.md read from a clone checked out at commit 72b563515251e26a51571d80d62661a3af3b2835 (committed 2026-10-13); the cited text was re-read at that revision.

claims.claim_vi: Data mesh is an organizational approach with four principles: domain ownership, data as a product, self-serve platform, federated computational governance.
claims.verified_by: Search-result excerpt only; the page itself was not opened (host blocked in the authoring environment).

claims.claim_vi: A data mart is commonly a subset of a warehouse for one group; the source describes it that way and the lesson hedges with 'thường là'.
claims.verified_by: Not stated on the opened page; carried from the source with a hedge.

design_notes_vi: Sáu thuật ngữ xếp theo bốn câu hỏi để thấy chúng không cùng loại; thẻ mesh dùng màu và chữ nhấn là cách tổ chức. Không dùng ảnh nguồn.
source_deviations: Source calls a data lake a pool of unstructured data; Google Cloud describes structured, semi-structured and unstructured data, so the lesson uses the broader statement.
Source says Delta Lake unifies batch and streaming; that claim was not checked against Delta documentation and is omitted.
editorial_note_vi: Bài mới viết trong kho này, chờ review kỹ thuật. Chưa user testing hoặc phê duyệt phát hành.
